articles.title: Shag: Formica Boomerang
articles.summary: Near-black teal laminate with sparse pale boomerang flecks and a fine semi-matte grain, no real metal, faint chrome edge strip. Reads as an almost black car with a faint teal cast and a light dusting of pale specks, like retro speckled laminate; the ticks shrink to tiny sparkles.
articles.what: Laminate with the little shapes on it, and a chrome edge strip. Up close: Very dark teal-black ground with a fine soft grain, scattered with small pale aqua-white curved ticks, like tiny commas, bananas and short boomerangs, each a few pixels to fingertip long and pointing every direction. They are sparse, mostly alone, with plenty of dark between. Colour is fixed dark. From a distance: Reads as an almost black car with a faint teal cast and a light dusting of pale specks, like retro speckled laminate; the ticks shrink to tiny sparkles.
